reflectionPrompts.text: What changed since your last check?
Do you think the panel's shade is helping your plant or hurting it? Why?
Is the soil drying out faster or slower than you expected? Why?
If you could move the panel, where would you put it? Why?
What did the panel power today? How well did it work?
How could a setup like this help a family in the desert?
What question do you want to test next?
Look at a classmate's plant. What is different about yours?
How much water did your plant need this week? How do you know?
